faq.q: Do I need a license to rent a boat in Estepona?
faq.a: No, you do not need a license. All our charters include a licensed skipper who handles navigation and safety. You just relax and enjoy the ride. This applies to all boats in our fleet, from the Dubhe speedboat to the Mangusta 80 luxury yacht.

faq.q: What is the price for a no-license boat rental in Estepona?
faq.a: Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39), which include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and 21% IVA. The Mangusta 80 costs €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats, like the Dubhe or Lagoon 380, are priced on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Where do the boats depart from?
faq.a: All boats depart from Puerto Banús, just a 10-minute drive from Estepona. You can reach us easily via the A-7 highway. The marina offers ample parking. From there, we cruise along the coast to Estepona, Cabopino, or Cala del Faro.

faq.q: What is included in the rental price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden fees. You only need to bring sunscreen and swimwear.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and drinks. Our standard package includes drinks and light snacks, but you can supplement with your own. Just note that glass bottles are not allowed on some boats for safety reasons – we recommend plastic or cans.

faq.q: What is the maximum number of passengers?
faq.a: It depends on the boat. The Dubhe (8m) takes up to 5 passengers, the speedboat (7m) up to 6, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m) up to 9, and the Azimut 39 (12.5m) up to 11. Larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 (24m) or Ferretti 94 (29m) can accommodate up to 12 passengers.

faq.q: Can we visit Estepona's beaches and coves?
faq.a: Absolutely. Popular stops include Cala del Faro, a hidden cove near Estepona, and Cabopino beach with its dunes. Your skipper will tailor the route to your preferences, whether you want to swim, snorkel, or just cruise along the Golden Mile.

faq.q: How do I book a no-license boat rental in Estepona?
faq.a: You can book directly via WhatsApp through our website. Just send us your preferred date, group size, and boat type. We'll confirm availability and send you a quote. Payment is secure, and you can cancel up to 48 hours before departure.

data.body_html:
Renting a boat in Estepona without a license is straightforward: every charter includes a licensed skipper, so you can focus on the views. Our fleet offers options from €749 for 2 hours on the Dubhe or Astondoa 40, up to €4,719 for 4 hours on the Mangusta 80. All depart from Puerto Banús, just 10 minutes from Estepona. Inclusions cover skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA. Explore the coast, swim at Cala del Faro, or anchor near Cabopino – no paperwork needed.

Why Choose a No-License Boat Rental in Estepona?

Estepona's coastline is dotted with coves and beaches that are best accessed by boat. With a skipper onboard, you avoid the hassle of licensing and navigation. Our boats are fully equipped with safety gear and insurance. Whether you want a quick 2-hour sunset cruise or a full-day adventure, we handle the logistics. The average sea temperature in summer is 24°C, perfect for swimming.

Our Fleet for No-License Rentals

We offer a range of boats, all with a skipper included. For small groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) are ideal. For larger parties, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) start at €749/2h. The Lagoon 380 catamaran (11.6m, 10 pax) offers stability and space. Luxury options like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) include a free jet ski. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

Popular Routes from Estepona

From Puerto Banús, you can cruise to Cala del Faro, a secluded cove near Estepona with crystal-clear water. Another favourite is Cabopino, known for its sand dunes and chiringuitos. For a longer trip, head to Marbella's Golden Mile or even Sotogrande. Your skipper will adapt the route to your wishes.

What's Included in Your Charter

  • Licensed skipper (no license needed from you)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)

  • 21% Spanish IVA (VAT)

No hidden costs. You can bring your own food and drinks (no glass on some boats).

How to Book

Booking is simple: contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and boat type. We'll confirm availability and send a quote. Payment is secure, and cancellations are free up to 48 hours before departure. For more details, visit our main page.
